newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian woman stabs Israeli policeman in Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian woman stabs Israeli policeman in Gaza.

text.p: A Palestinian woman stabbed and lightly wounded an Israeli border policeman on Tuesday near a Jewish settlement in the Gaza Strip, the army said.
Palestinian police Brigadier-General Saeb al-Ajez said the assailant, 32, came from Bureij refugee camp. Police said she was released last week from a mental institution.
Police, patrolling in the area controlled jointly by Israel and the PLO, said they jumped on her and brought her under control to prevent Israeli soldiers from firing at her.
The army said the border policeman was taken to a clinic for treatment.
Israel handed over parts of Gaza to Palestinian rule in 1994 but some troops remained in the Strip to safeguard Jewish settlements and patrol main roads.
